output.explanation: Checks that any site marked ACTIVE also has an activated_on date. Sites with any other status are accepted whether or not they have an activation date.
fails_when: status is exactly "ACTIVE" and activated_on is missing (null)
Surprising: the comparison is case-sensitive, so "active" or "Active" is not treated as ACTIVE and always passes
Surprising: a status with extra whitespace such as "ACTIVE " also passes without needing activated_on
passes_when: status is anything other than "ACTIVE" (e.g. "PENDING", "CLOSED"), regardless of activated_on
status is "ACTIVE" and activated_on has a date
status is missing (null): null is not equal to "ACTIVE", so the row passes, assuming null comparison is evaluated as not-equal
